The newest builds of Switchboard, made and tested automatically from `main`. These links always give the newest one:

- **Phone app (Android):** [switchboard-home.apk](https://github.com/fawadeqbal/smart-home-automation/releases/latest/download/switchboard-home.apk)
- **Board firmware:** [home_node.bin](https://github.com/fawadeqbal/smart-home-automation/releases/latest/download/home_node.bin) (every version is also kept under its own `firmware-v…` release)

### Install the phone app
1. Open the `.apk` link on the Android phone and download it.
2. Open the downloaded file. If Android asks, allow installing apps from your browser or files app.
3. A newer build installs over the old one; you stay signed in.

### Update the boards
1. In the web app, open any board > **Firmware** > **Upload build** and choose `home_node.bin`.
2. Install it on one board, or roll it out to all boards from the console.

A brand-new board is flashed once over USB first: see `firmware/README.md`.
